notes.title: Prologue cancelled and demo launched!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We finally decided to cancel the prologue due to the new demo system on Steam. The page was created before the Steam announcement, and we think the both package will be too similar.

You can now download the demo and leave a review directly on the demo page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160750/Spin_Hero_Demo/

If you have any feedback, feel free to join our discord.

The launch is planning for the next month! We will announce it soon.

have fun
Johann
